geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the dominant mass around a clear public void to support the neighborhood active-edge brief.
Open the court toward the access edge.
Increase the carved public ground proportion so the threshold becomes readable.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the dominant split-wing articulation into a clearer courtyard/public-void organizer so the access edge can read as a public threshold rather than a sealed mass.
Align the public void/opening to the verified program access side in the program frame.
Reserve enough carved ground space to make the court/threshold legible in plan and section.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant bar-with-split mass in all four views, so gesture and hierarchy are present. However, the public/open-space response is weak: the blue access edge is mostly met by a sealed or near-sealed ground condition rather than a clear court, entry seam, or undercut aligned to the access side. The mass also feels somewhat arbitrary in section, with a bent/tapered split-wing logic that does not fully resolve into a legible neighborhood ground threshold or a clearly programmatic upper hierarchy. Compared with the references, it has some resonance with compact commercial bars and courtyard-driven neighborhood massing, but it lacks the explicit public void and frontage articulation those precedents make obvious. The result is visually coherent but not yet program-secure for neighborhood living because the active edge and public space invariant are underdeveloped.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact commercial bar mass with lively ground-edge punctures and a legible public threshold.
Courtyard-first massing that uses void as the organizing public room.
Small neighborhood-scaled frontage with a simple sheltered public edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Typologically farther from neighborhood living; tower language should not be copied.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Grounded podium-to-tower hierarchy and terraced lower mass can inform public threshold logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual only; its looping section is too large and too residential-resort-like for this brief.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Sectional public circulation and carved communal voids could inspire a more public ground/roof relationship.

warnings: Parcel containment appears satisfied in the visible views, but the access edge response is not convincingly legible.
The blue frontage is not translated into a clear public threshold; this is the main semantic weakness.
Do not over-interpret the stepped/tapered geometry as sectionally programmatic; it currently reads more as formal deformation than inhabitable section.
